page.layout: One block of verse in the centre; running head across the top; a catchword-like word at the lower right margin; small annotation at the right edge ("Abramus") set apart at the foot.

p.i: Huic rapta coniux ad Pharij domum
Fauore summi,Ut tot sua cum Lotho

page.notes: Faint show-through and stains on the page; the lower-right "Abramus" is a catchword. Some words in the verse are doubtful, notably "Sberes", "Someribus", "Sbiflebilem", and "Serendos", which are copied as printed but may be misread.
